_note: Every ability/keyword the app can show, keyed by id. Core and weapon abilities are short summaries of core rules section 24; army rules and datasheet abilities are summaries of the Orks pages. All checked against Wahapedia's 11th edition pages on 2026-10-12, except the entries marked Combat Patrol, which Wahapedia does not carry. Keys starting with an underscore are ignored by the loader.

waaagh.name: Waaagh!
waaagh.description:
Friendly ORKS units with this ability can re-roll Advance rolls, and can become riled up when another rule says so.

While a unit is riled up:
• It has a 5+ invulnerable save.
• Its ranged attacks have [ASSAULT].
• Making an Advance move does not stop it from declaring a charge.

War Cry (once per battle, per army): at the start of the Command phase you can call it. Every friendly ORKS unit with this ability is then riled up until the end of the next turn.
waaagh._call_note: These keys drive the call button and the tracker's WAAAGH! toggle for MATCHED PLAY datasheets. Combat Patrol datasheets point at waaagh-combat-patrol instead, which has its own wording and effects.
waaagh.callWhen: Start of the Command phase · once per battle
waaagh.callDuration: Until the end of the next turn
waaagh.callEffect:
Units with Waaagh! are riled up:
• 5+ invulnerable save.
• Ranged attacks have [ASSAULT].
• Can declare a charge after Advancing.
waaagh._callState_note: callState names the state the call puts units in; it labels the note on unit cards and the badge on stratagems. callNotes are the call's effects that have no number to change, listed on every affected card.
callNotes: Can declare a charge after Advancing
waaagh._callEffects_note: Applied live to unit cards while the call is active, and only to units whose factionAbilities include this ability. invulnerableSave improves a worse save and never downgrades a better one. weaponAbilities adds a badge to matching weapon rows unless the weapon already has that ability. The charge bullet has no stat to change, so it lives in the text only.

waaagh-combat-patrol.name: Waaagh!
waaagh-combat-patrol._cp_note: The Waaagh! as the 'Ardmob Combat Patrol datasheets use it, kept exactly as it was before the 11th edition sync. The Combat Patrol detachment rule and stratagems are written against this wording ('with the Waaagh! active'). Wahapedia has no Combat Patrol pages, so this entry is NOT verified — check it against the Combat Patrol rules in the box or the official app.
waaagh-combat-patrol.description:
If your Army Faction is ORKS, once per battle, at the start of your Command phase, you can call a Waaagh!. If you do, until the start of your next Command phase, the Waaagh! is active for your army and:
• Units from your army with this ability are eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which they Advanced.
• Add 1 to the Strength and Attacks characteristics of melee weapons equipped by models from your army with this ability.
• Models from your army with this ability have a 5+ invulnerable save.
waaagh-combat-patrol.callWhen: Start of the Command phase · once per battle
waaagh-combat-patrol.callDuration: Until the start of your next Command phase
waaagh-combat-patrol.callEffect:
• Eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which they Advanced.
• +1 S and +1 A on melee weapons.
• 5+ invulnerable save.
waaagh-combat-patrol._callEffects_note: Applied live to unit cards while the call is active, and only to units whose factionAbilities include this ability. Changed values pulse green. The charge bullet has no stat to change, so it lives in the text only.
waaagh-combat-patrol._callGif_note: Optional background flourish played when the button is pressed. Drop the file at this path; if it is missing or fails to load, nothing happens and the button behaves exactly as before. Remove this key to switch the flourish off.

da-boss.name: Da Boss
da-boss.description: At the start of each battle round, if a model with this ability is your WARLORD, you gain 1CP.

unstable-energies.name: Unstable Energies
unstable-energies.description:
An ORKS PSYKER unit with this ability has a psyker level, given in its abilities, and each psychic ability has a psychic level, given in its name.

In each battle round, the psychic abilities a unit uses cannot add up to more psychic levels than its psyker level — a level 3 psyker could use three level 1 abilities, a level 1 and a level 2, or a single level 3.

supreme-commander.name: Supreme Commander
supreme-commander.description: If this model is in your army, it must be your WARLORD.

da-grand-warlords-ladz.name: Da Grand Warlord’s Ladz
da-grand-warlords-ladz.description: While this unit is within 3" of another friendly ORKS INFANTRY unit, it has Lone Operative.

makari-hoist-dat-banner.name: Makari, Hoist Dat Banner!
makari-hoist-dat-banner.description:
Once per battle, per army: in your Movement phase, select a number of friendly ORKS units up to the current battle round number. Those units are riled up until the start of your next turn.

Keep a Makari token next to this unit and remove it once the ability has been used.

prophet-of-da-great-waaagh.name: Prophet of da Great Waaagh! (Aura)
prophet-of-da-great-waaagh.description:
While a friendly ORKS unit is within 6" of this unit, that unit’s melee attacks have:
• +1 to Hit rolls.
• +1 to Wound rolls.

grab-dat-scrap.name: Grab Dat Scrap
grab-dat-scrap.description: While this unit is engaged, this unit has +1 OC.

totem-of-mork.name: Totem of Mork (Psychic)
totem-of-mork.description: At the end of your Command phase, if this unit is controlling an objective, that objective is secured.

smash-em-up.name: Smash 'Em Up
smash-em-up.description:
In the Fight phase, when this unit is selected to fight, this unit's melee attacks have:
• [LETHAL HITS].
• Or: [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

indiscriminate-detonations.name: Indiscriminate Detonations
indiscriminate-detonations.description:
In your Shooting phase, when this unit has shot, select one enemy unit hit by those attacks. That unit is suppressed until the start of your next turn:
• While a unit is suppressed, that unit's attacks have -1 to hit rolls.

grot-infestation.name: Grot Infestation (Once per battle per unit)
grot-infestation.description:
When this unit is destroyed, you can use this ability. If you do:
• Place this unit in strategic reserves with all of this unit's destroyed models returned to it. This unit is no longer destroyed.
This unit has Deep Strike.

adrenaline-junkies.name: Adrenaline Junkies
adrenaline-junkies.description:
When this SPEED FREEKS unit is selected to make an Advance or Fall Back move:
• Its ranged attacks have [ASSAULT] until the end of the turn.
• That move does not stop it from declaring a charge.

brute-bosses-ard-as-nails.name: ’Ard as Nails
brute-bosses-ard-as-nails.description: When this WARBOSS model is destroyed, if its unit has not been selected to fight this phase, roll one D6, adding 1 if the unit is riled up. On a 3+ the model is not removed yet: it stays on the battlefield until its unit has fought or the phase ends, whichever comes first.

powers-of-da-waaagh.name: Powers of da Waaagh!
powers-of-da-waaagh.description:
[PSYCHIC] attacks made by friendly ORKS PSYKER models have +1 S, and a further +1 S for every 5 models in that model’s unit (or embarked within that model).

Friendly ORKS PSYKER models also have these psychic abilities:

Roar of Mork (psychic level 1): in your Movement phase, if this unit is not Battle-shocked, you can make a psychic roll for it (one D6). If you do:
• On a 1, this unit is Battle-shocked.
• Select one enemy unit (excluding MONSTER and VEHICLE units) within 12". It makes a Battle-shock roll, with -1 for every 10 models in this unit.

Visions of Violence (psychic level 1): at the start of the Fight phase, if this unit is not Battle-shocked, you can make a psychic roll for it (one D6). If you do:
• On a 1, this unit is Battle-shocked.
• This unit has Fights First.

Psychic levels are spent against the unit’s psyker level each battle round — see Unstable Energies.

psychic.name: Psychic
psychic.description: You can ignore any or all modifiers to this attack’s BS or WS and to its Hit roll. Attacks made with a [PSYCHIC] weapon count as psychic attacks, which other rules can key off.

cleave.name: Cleave
cleave.description: [CLEAVE X]: if every attack from this weapon goes into a single target, gain X extra attack dice for every five models that were in that unit when targets were selected (rounding down).

close-quarters.name: Close-quarters
close-quarters.description:
A unit with a [CLOSE-QUARTERS] weapon can shoot while engaged, using close-quarters shooting (core rules 10.06) — those weapons can then target the units it is engaged with.

When shooting any other way, each model that is not a MONSTER or VEHICLE fires either its [CLOSE-QUARTERS] weapons or its other ranged weapons, not both.

lethal-hits.name: Lethal Hits
lethal-hits.description:
Each Critical Hit can be treated as an automatic wound (your choice). No Wound roll is made for it, so it cannot become a Critical Wound.

If keywords follow the name, as in [LETHAL HITS: non-MONSTER/VEHICLE], it only works against targets that match.

sustained-hits.name: Sustained Hits
sustained-hits.description: [SUSTAINED HITS X]: each Critical Hit scores X additional hits on the target.

devastating-wounds.name: Devastating Wounds
devastating-wounds.description: A Critical Wound ends that attack’s sequence and deals mortal wounds equal to the weapon’s D instead, applied after any normal damage from those attacks. Each Critical Wound can damage only one model; any excess is lost.

rapid-fire.name: Rapid Fire
rapid-fire.description: [RAPID FIRE X]: gain X extra attack dice if the target was within half the weapon’s range when targets were selected.

assault.name: Assault
assault.description: A unit with one or more [ASSAULT] weapons can still shoot after Advancing, using assault shooting (core rules 10.05) — but only with its [ASSAULT] weapons.

heavy.name: Heavy
heavy.description: In your Shooting phase, add 1 to the Hit roll if the attacking unit is unengaged, was not set up on the battlefield this turn, and none of its models has moved more than 3" this turn.

pistol.name: Pistol
pistol.description: Identical to [CLOSE-QUARTERS] for all rules purposes — it is the older name for the same ability.

blast.name: Blast
blast.description: Gain 1 extra attack dice for every five models that were in the target unit when targets were selected (rounding down). [BLAST X] adds X per five models instead.

torrent.name: Torrent
torrent.description: Attacks made with this weapon automatically hit. A [TORRENT] weapon cannot also have [INDIRECT FIRE] or [PRECISION].

precision.name: Precision
precision.description: If the target unit contains a CHARACTER model visible to an attacking model, you can choose for these attacks to be allocated to that CHARACTER’s allocation group first — until the attacks are resolved or that group is destroyed.

ignores-cover.name: Ignores Cover
ignores-cover.description: The target cannot have the Benefit of Cover against this attack, including cover handed out by rules such as Stealth.

hazardous.name: Hazardous
hazardous.description: After the unit has resolved all its attacks, make one hazard roll for each [HAZARDOUS] weapon it used. A hazard roll is one D6: on a 1-2 the unit suffers 1 mortal wound, or 3 if every model in it is a MONSTER or VEHICLE.

melta.name: Melta
melta.description: [MELTA X]: add X to the weapon’s D if the target was within half range when targets were selected.

lance.name: Lance
lance.description: Add 1 to the Wound roll if the attacking model’s unit made a Charge move this turn.

twin-linked.name: Twin-linked
twin-linked.description: You can re-roll the Wound roll.

extra-attacks.name: Extra Attacks
extra-attacks.description: The bearer attacks with all of its [EXTRA ATTACKS] weapons as well as one of its other melee weapons, not instead of it.

anti.name: Anti-
anti.description: [ANTI-X Y+]: against a target with keyword X, an unmodified Wound roll of Y+ is a Critical Wound.

indirect-fire.name: Indirect Fire
indirect-fire.description: A unit with an [INDIRECT FIRE] weapon can use indirect shooting (core rules 10.07) to target units it cannot see. Those attacks cannot re-roll Hit rolls, the target has the Benefit of Cover, and unmodified Hit rolls of 1-5 fail — or only 1-3 if the unit Remained Stationary and the target is visible to another friendly unit.

leader.name: Leader
leader.description: When you muster your army, this unit can be attached to one Bodyguard unit it is able to lead, forming an Attached unit. A Bodyguard unit can have one Leader and one Support unit.

deep-strike.name: Deep Strike
deep-strike.description: When this unit makes an ingress move, it can be set up anywhere more than 8" horizontally from all enemy units — even in the enemy deployment zone — provided every model in it has this ability.

scouts.name: Scouts
scouts.description: Scouts X": before the battle, if every model in the unit has this ability, a unit wholly within your deployment zone can make a scout move of up to X", ending more than 8" horizontally from all enemy units. A unit in Strategic Reserves can instead be set up wholly within your deployment zone. A DEDICATED TRANSPORT can make the move if every model embarked within it has Scouts.

infiltrators.name: Infiltrators
infiltrators.description: During deployment, if every model in the unit has this ability, it can be set up anywhere more than 8" horizontally from the enemy deployment zone and all enemy units.

stealth.name: Stealth
stealth.description: If every model in the unit has this ability, the unit has the Benefit of Cover against ranged attacks — which worsens the attack’s BS by 1.

lone-operative.name: Lone Operative
lone-operative.description: Unless it is part of an Attached unit, this unit is only visible to enemy models within 12", and [INDIRECT FIRE] weapons can only target it from within 12". Lone Operative X" uses X" instead.

fights-first.name: Fights First
fights-first.description: While every model in the unit has this ability, it is a Fights First unit and fights in the Fights First step of the Fight phase.

feel-no-pain-4.name: Feel No Pain 4+
feel-no-pain-4.description: Each time this model would lose a wound, roll one D6: on a 4+, that wound is not lost.

feel-no-pain-5.name: Feel No Pain 5+
feel-no-pain-5.description: Each time this model would lose a wound, roll one D6: on a 5+, that wound is not lost.

feel-no-pain-6.name: Feel No Pain 6+
feel-no-pain-6.description: Each time this model would lose a wound, roll one D6: on a 6+, that wound is not lost.

deadly-demise.name: Deadly Demise
deadly-demise.description: Deadly Demise X: when this model is destroyed — after anything embarked within it has made its emergency disembark move — roll one D6. On a 6, each unit within 6" suffers X mortal wounds, rolled separately for each unit if X is random.

firing-deck.name: Firing Deck
firing-deck.description: Firing Deck X: in your Shooting phase, when this TRANSPORT is selected to shoot, pick up to X embarked models whose units have not shot this phase, and one ranged weapon from each (not [ONE SHOT]). The TRANSPORT fires those weapons as its own, and its passengers cannot shoot for the rest of the turn.

support.name: Support
support.description: When you muster your army, this unit must be attached to one Bodyguard unit it is able to join, forming an Attached unit with it. A Bodyguard unit can have one Support unit as well as one Leader.

hunter.name: Hunter
hunter.description: A Hunter profile can only be used against units that have the keywords it names — [HUNTER: MONSTER/VEHICLE] can only target MONSTER or VEHICLE units. Pick one of the weapon’s eligible profiles before selecting targets.

kunnin-infiltrator.name: Kunnin’ Infiltrator
kunnin-infiltrator.description: At the end of your opponent’s Fight phase, if every model in this unit is hidden and unengaged, you can place the unit into Strategic Reserves.

deff-from-the-shadows.name: Deff from the Shadows
deff-from-the-shadows.description: From the first battle round onwards: at the end of your opponent’s Movement phase, if this unit is in Strategic Reserves, it can make an ingress move.

intimidating-motivation.name: Intimidating Motivation
intimidating-motivation.type: Ability — Warboss, Warboss in Mega Armour, Nazdreg
intimidating-motivation.description:
Once per battle round, per army. In your Movement phase, at the start or end of this unit’s move, you can select one friendly ORKS unit within 6" of this unit. That unit:
• Is no longer Battle-shocked.
• Is riled up until the start of your next turn.

nazdregs-know-wotz.name: Nazdreg’s Know-wotz
nazdregs-know-wotz.description: This unit has Deep Strike, and its ranged attacks have [IGNORES COVER].

supreme-kunnin.name: Supreme Kunnin’
supreme-kunnin.description: Once per phase, per army: in your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of this unit, if this unit is unengaged it can make a Normal move of up to D6" — or of up to 5" if it is riled up.

super-runts.name: Super Runts
super-runts.description: This unit is riled up, and its Scavenged Shivs weapons have +1 to their A, WS and S.

one-last-kill.name: One Last Kill
one-last-kill.description: In the Fight phase, when this model is destroyed, if its unit has not been selected to fight this phase, roll one D6. On a 2+ the model is not removed yet: it stays on the battlefield until the unit has fought or the phase ends, whichever comes first.

da-bigger-dey-iz.name: Da Bigger Dey Iz…
da-bigger-dey-iz.description: This unit’s melee attacks that target a MONSTER or VEHICLE unit can re-roll the Wound roll.

beast-snagga-following.name: Beast Snagga Following
beast-snagga-following.description: While this unit is within 3" of a friendly BEAST SNAGGA unit (excluding MONSTER CHARACTER units), it has Lone Operative.

full-throttle.name: Full Throttle
full-throttle.description: In your Command phase, select one Throttlerokkit Shokka Engine ability: Turbo Engine, Shokk Attack Engine or Pulse Jet. This unit has that ability until the start of your next Command phase.

turbo-engine.name: Turbo Engine
turbo-engine.type: Throttlerokkit Shokka Engine ability — Wazdakka Gutsmek
turbo-engine.description: Only while selected with Full Throttle. When this unit is selected to make an Advance or Fall Back move, that move does not stop it from declaring a charge.

shokk-attack-engine.name: Shokk Attack Engine
shokk-attack-engine.type: Throttlerokkit Shokka Engine ability — Wazdakka Gutsmek
shokk-attack-engine.description: Only while selected with Full Throttle. In your Command phase, if this unit is unengaged, you can place it into Strategic Reserves.

pulse-jet.name: Pulse Jet
pulse-jet.type: Throttlerokkit Shokka Engine ability — Wazdakka Gutsmek
pulse-jet.description:
Only while selected with Full Throttle. In your Movement phase, when this unit is selected to move, if it is unengaged it can make a pulse jet move.

Pulse jet move: roll one D6 and move up to that plus 18". The move ignores vertical distance and can pass through models and through terrain. The unit must end unengaged, cannot declare a charge or start an action until the end of the turn, and until the start of your next turn attacks that target it have -1 to Hit rolls.

waaagh-banner.name: Waaagh! Banner
waaagh-banner.description: This unit has +1 to Charge rolls.

keep-huntin.name: Keep Huntin’!
keep-huntin.description:
Once per battle round, per army. In your Movement phase, at the start or end of this unit’s move, you can select one friendly BEAST SNAGGA unit within 6" of this unit. That unit:
• Is no longer Battle-shocked.
• Is riled up until the start of your next turn.

dodge-dis.name: Dodge Dis!
dodge-dis.description: This unit’s attacks have +1 to Hit rolls.

more-dakka.name: More Dakka
more-dakka.type: Ability — Big Mek, Big Mek in Mega Armour, Big Mek with Shokk Attack Gun
more-dakka.description: This unit’s ranged attacks have [IGNORES COVER] — and [SUSTAINED HITS 1] as well while the unit is riled up.

shokk-boosta.name: Shokk-boosta
shokk-boosta.description:
In your Movement phase, when this unit is selected to make an Advance move, you can use this ability. If you do:
• The Advance roll can be changed to a 6.
• The unit can move through all types of model.
• When it ends that move, make a hazard roll for each model in the unit.

fix-dat-armour-up.name: Fix Dat Armour Up
fix-dat-armour-up.type: Ability — Big Mek in Mega Armour
fix-dat-armour-up.description: Once per battle, per unit: in your Command phase, this unit heals 3 wounds. Keep a Grot Oiler token next to the unit and remove it when the ability is used.

kustom-force-field.name: Kustom Force Field
kustom-force-field.description: This unit has a 4+ invulnerable save against ranged attacks.

support-shokka.name: Support Shokka
support-shokka.type: Ability — Big Mek with Shokk Attack Gun
support-shokka.description: While this model is within 3" of a friendly ORKS INFANTRY unit (excluding BIG MEK WITH SHOKK ATTACK GUN units), it has Lone Operative.

sumfin-to-prove.name: Sumfin’ to Prove
sumfin-to-prove.description: This unit’s melee attacks have +1 to Hit rolls.

kustom-dakka.name: Kustom Dakka
kustom-dakka.description: This unit’s ranged attacks have [IGNORES COVER].

clever-know-wotz.name: Clever Know-wotz
clever-know-wotz.description:
In your Movement phase, at the start or end of this unit’s move, you can select one friendly ORKS VEHICLE model (excluding AIRCRAFT and TITANIC models) within 3" of this model:
• That model heals D3 wounds.
• Its attacks have +1 to Hit rolls until the start of your next Movement phase.

push-dat-bit-back-in.name: Push Dat Bit Back In
push-dat-bit-back-in.description: Once per battle, per unit: in your Command phase, select one friendly BEAST SNAGGA unit within 6" of this unit. That unit heals 3 wounds. Keep a Grot Orderly token next to the unit and remove it when the ability is used.

hardy-bioniks.name: Hardy Bioniks
hardy-bioniks.description: Attacks that target this unit with a S greater than this unit’s T have -1 to Wound rolls.

runnin-wiv-da-herd.name: Runnin’ wiv da Herd
runnin-wiv-da-herd.description:
While this model is attached to a MOUNTED unit, it:
• Does not have INFANTRY.
• Has MOBILE and MOUNTED.
• Has +4" M.

crude-surgery.name: Crude Surgery
crude-surgery.description: In your Command phase, this unit heals 3 wounds.

catch-dat-red-bit.name: Catch Dat Red Bit
catch-dat-red-bit.description: Once per battle, per unit: when this model uses Crude Surgery, you can add D3 to the number of wounds healed. Keep a Grot Orderly token next to the unit and remove it when the ability is used.

thatll-learn-ya.name: That’ll Learn Ya
thatll-learn-ya.description:
Once per battle round, per unit: when this unit becomes Battle-shocked, if it contains 4 or more Gretchin models, you can roll one D3:
• That many Gretchin models in this unit are destroyed.
• This unit is no longer Battle-shocked.

boss-ammo-runt.name: Boss’ Ammo Runt
boss-ammo-runt.description: Once per battle, per unit: in your Shooting phase, when this unit is selected to shoot, you can use this ability. If you do, this model’s ranged attacks have +1 to Hit rolls. Keep a Boss’ Ammo Runt token next to the unit and remove it when the ability is used.

might-is-right.name: Might Is Right
might-is-right.description:
If this unit made a Charge move this turn, this model’s melee attacks have:
• +3 A.
• +2 S.

krushin-impetus.name: Krushin’ Impetus
krushin-impetus.description: When this unit ends a Charge move, you can select one enemy unit engaged with it. If you do, roll one D6 for each model in this unit that is engaged with that enemy unit: for each 3+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound.

waaagh-energy.name: Waaagh! Energy (psyker level 1)
waaagh-energy.description: This model has the psychic abilities Da Jump and Warpath. Its psyker level limits how many psychic levels it can use each battle round — see Unstable Energies.

da-jump.name: Da Jump (Psychic, level 1)
da-jump.description:
Once per army, per battle round: in your Movement phase, if this unit is not Battle-shocked, you can make a psychic roll for it (one D6). If you do:
• On a 1, this unit is Battle-shocked.
• Place this unit into Strategic Reserves.
• This unit has Deep Strike.

warpath.name: Warpath (Psychic, level 1)
warpath.description:
In the Fight phase, when this unit is selected to fight, if it is not Battle-shocked, you can make a psychic roll for it (one D6). If you do:
• On a 1, this unit is Battle-shocked.
• This unit’s melee attacks can re-roll Wound rolls of 1.
• This unit’s melee attacks have [PSYCHIC].

thundering-stampede.name: Thundering Stampede (Aura)
thundering-stampede.description: Friendly BEAST SNAGGA units within 6" of this unit have +1 to Charge rolls.

boss-of-da-hunt.name: Boss of da Hunt
boss-of-da-hunt.description: While this unit is within 3" of a friendly BEAST SNAGGA unit (excluding MONSTER CHARACTER units), it has Lone Operative.

get-back-in-da-race.name: Get Back in da Race!
get-back-in-da-race.description:
Once per battle round, per army. In your Movement phase, at the start or end of this unit’s move, you can select one friendly SPEED FREEKS unit within 6" of this unit. That unit, and any units embarked within it:
• Is no longer Battle-shocked.
• Is riled up until the start of your next turn.

fuel-mixa-grot.name: Fuel-mixa Grot
fuel-mixa-grot.description: This unit has +1 to Advance rolls.

even-more-dakka.name: Even More Dakka
even-more-dakka.description: While this unit is riled up, its ranged attacks have [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

blitz-dem-gitz.name: Blitz Dem Gitz!
blitz-dem-gitz.description: In your Shooting phase, if this unit’s Blitzkannon targets a unit that is not a MONSTER or VEHICLE, that weapon has +6 A.

ammo-runts.name: Ammo Runts
ammo-runts.description: Once per battle, per unit: in your Shooting phase, when this unit is selected to shoot, you can use this ability. If you do, the unit’s ranged attacks have +1 to Hit rolls. Keep Ammo Runt tokens next to the unit and remove them when the ability is used.

tide-of-muscle.name: Tide of Muscle
tide-of-muscle.description: In the Fight phase, if this unit made a Charge move this turn, its melee attacks have [LETHAL HITS].

never-too-busy-to-fight.name: Never Too Busy to Fight
never-too-busy-to-fight.description: Being engaged does not stop this unit from starting an action.

mobbed.name: Mobbed
mobbed.description:
When this unit ends a Charge move, each enemy MONSTER or VEHICLE unit engaged with it makes a Battle-shock roll:
• With -1 to that roll.
• Or: with -2 to that roll if this unit has 13 or more models.

damaged.name: Damaged
damaged.description: Damaged X: while this model has X or fewer wounds remaining it is damaged, and its attacks have -1 to Hit rolls.

super-heavy-walker.name: Super-heavy Walker
super-heavy-walker.description:
Each time this unit makes a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move:
• Its models can move through other models (MONSTER and VEHICLE models included, TITANIC ones not), and horizontally through parts of terrain features that are 4" or less in height.
• Before it moves, you can give all its models the MOBILE keyword until the move ends, which lets them cross dense terrain. If you do, roll one D6 when the move ends: on a 1, the unit is Battle-shocked.

bomb-squig.name: Bomb Squig
bomb-squig.description: Once per battle, per unit: in your Movement phase, when this unit ends a Normal move, you can pick one visible enemy unit within 12" and roll one D6. On a 3+, it suffers D3 mortal wounds. Keep one Bomb Squig token next to the unit and remove it when the ability is used.

bomb-squigs.name: Bomb Squigs
bomb-squigs.description: Once per turn, twice per battle, per unit: in your Movement phase, when this unit ends a Normal move, you can pick one visible enemy unit within 12" and roll one D6. On a 3+, it suffers D3 mortal wounds. Keep two Bomb Squig tokens next to the unit and remove one each time the ability is used.

gut-hatch.name: Gut Hatch
gut-hatch.description: In your Movement phase, when this unit ends a Normal move, the units embarked within it can make an assault disembark move.

pilin-out.name: Pilin’ Out
pilin-out.description: In your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of this model, the units embarked within it can make a disembark move, using the rapid disembark mode.

boom-bomb.name: Boom Bomb
boom-bomb.description:
At the end of your opponent’s Fight phase, pick one visible enemy unit within 24" of this unit (not a Lone Operative unit) and roll one D6:
• 1-3: it suffers D3 mortal wounds.
• 4-5: it suffers 3 mortal wounds.
• 6: it suffers D3+3 mortal wounds.

burna-bomb.name: Burna Bomb
burna-bomb.description:
At the end of your opponent’s Fight phase, pick one visible enemy unit within 36" of this unit (not a Lone Operative, MONSTER or VEHICLE unit) and roll one D6. On a 2+:
• It suffers D3 mortal wounds.
• It cannot be hidden until the end of your next turn.
• Ranged attacks that target it have [IGNORES COVER] until the end of your next turn.

strafing-run.name: Strafing Run
strafing-run.description: In your Shooting phase, this unit’s ranged attacks have +1 to Hit rolls unless the target is a FLY unit.

go-fer-da-weak-spot.name: Go fer da Weak Spot
go-fer-da-weak-spot.description: In your Shooting phase, this unit’s ranged attacks that target a MONSTER or VEHICLE unit have +1 to Wound rolls.

blastajet-force-field.name: Blastajet Force Field
blastajet-force-field.description: Models in this unit have a 5+ invulnerable save, and do not have the SMOKE keyword.

trophy-hunters.name: Trophy Hunters
trophy-hunters.description: This unit has +1 to Charge rolls.

finderz-keeperz.name: Finderz Keeperz
finderz-keeperz.description:
In your Shooting phase, this unit’s ranged attacks have +1 AP while either of these is true:
• This unit is within range of an objective.
• The target of the attack is within range of an objective.

downtrodden.name: Downtrodden
downtrodden.description: When working out transport capacity, every 2 Gretchin models (rounding up) take up the space of 1 model.

thievin-scavengers.name: Thievin’ Scavengers
thievin-scavengers.description: At the end of your Movement phase, if this unit controls an objective, that objective is secured.

found-em.name: Found ’Em!
found-em.description: In your Movement phase, you can pick one enemy unit within 12" of this unit: it has +3" detection range until the end of the turn. Put a Kommando Grot token next to that unit as a reminder.

taktikal-know-wotz.name: Taktikal Know-wotz
taktikal-know-wotz.description: In the Declare Battle Formations step, you can split this unit into two units, each with a starting strength of 5. If you do, choose which of the two has the Bomb Squig ability and which has Found ’Em!.

nowhere-to-hide.name: Nowhere to Hide
nowhere-to-hide.description: This unit’s attacks that target a hidden unit have +1 to Hit rolls.

arrogant-invulnerability.name: Arrogant Invulnerability
arrogant-invulnerability.description: Each attack that targets this unit has -1 AP.

krumpin-time.name: Krumpin’ Time
krumpin-time.description: In the Fight phase, while this unit is riled up, it has +1 to Hit rolls.

get-out-da-way.name: Get Out da Way!
get-out-da-way.description: While making a Charge move, this unit can move through models (not MONSTER or VEHICLE models).

paired-krumpas.name: Paired Krumpas
paired-krumpas.description: Attacks made with this model’s Kustom Krumpa can re-roll Hit rolls and Wound rolls.

rokkit-charge.name: Rokkit Charge
rokkit-charge.description: When this unit is selected to fight, if it made a Charge move this turn, you can use this ability. If you do, its melee attacks have +1 Attacks, +1 Strength and [HAZARDOUS].

rokkit-barrage.name: Rokkit Barrage
rokkit-barrage.description: In your Shooting phase, after this unit has shot, pick one enemy unit hit by those attacks. That unit makes a Battle-shock roll with -1 to the roll.

pulsa-rokkit.name: Pulsa Rokkit
pulsa-rokkit.description: Once per battle, per unit: in your Shooting phase, when this unit is selected to shoot, you can pick one enemy MONSTER or VEHICLE unit within 24" of it. If you do, this unit’s attacks that target that unit have +1 AP and [LETHAL HITS].

fully-loaded-butchery.name: Fully Loaded Butchery
fully-loaded-butchery.description: This unit’s Butcha Boyz weapon has +2 Attacks for each model embarked within the unit, up to +22.

tramplasquig-charge.name: Tramplasquig Charge
tramplasquig-charge.description: When you target this unit with the Crushing Impact stratagem, it costs 1 CP less.

wurrboy.name: Wurrboy (psyker level 1)
wurrboy.description: This model has the psychic abilities Beastscent and Warpath. Its psyker level limits how many psychic levels it can use each battle round — see Unstable Energies.

beastscent.name: Beastscent (Psychic, level 1)
beastscent.description:
In your Movement phase, when a unit embarked within this unit is selected to make a disembark move, if this unit is not Battle-shocked, you can make a psychic roll for it (one D6). If you do:
• On a 1, this unit is Battle-shocked.
• Until the end of the turn, the disembarking unit’s attacks that target a MONSTER or VEHICLE unit have +1 to Wound rolls.

warpath-kill-rig.name: Warpath (Psychic, level 1)
warpath-kill-rig.description:
In the Fight phase, when this unit is selected to fight, if it is not Battle-shocked, you can make a psychic roll for it (one D6). If you do:
• On a 1, this unit is Battle-shocked.
• This unit’s melee attacks have [LETHAL HITS] and [PSYCHIC].

walking-bastion.name: Walking Bastion
walking-bastion.description: This unit’s attacks can ignore modifiers to Ballistic Skill, Weapon Skill and Hit rolls.

deff-from-above.name: Deff from Above
deff-from-above.description: In your Shooting phase, if this unit made an ingress move this turn, its ranged attacks have +1 to Hit rolls.

aerial-manoover.name: Aerial Manoover
aerial-manoover.description: At the end of your opponent’s Fight phase, if this unit is unengaged, you can place it into Strategic Reserves.

brutal-impact.name: Brutal Impact
brutal-impact.description: If this unit made a Charge move this turn, its attacks have +1 Damage.

high-speed-carnage.name: High-speed Carnage
high-speed-carnage.description: If this unit made a Charge move this turn, its melee attacks have +1 Strength and +1 Damage.

speednob-support.name: Speednob Support
speednob-support.description: While every model in this unit is within 3" of a friendly SPEED FREEKS unit (other than a WARTRAKK unit), this unit has Lone Operative.

bust-em.name: Bust ’Em
bust-em.description: In your Shooting phase, after this unit has shot, pick one enemy unit hit by those attacks. Until the end of the turn that unit is busted: friendly SPEED FREEKS units’ attacks that target it have [LETHAL HITS].

big-an-stompy.name: Big an’ Stompy
big-an-stompy.description: This unit’s melee attacks can re-roll Hit rolls of 1.

big-an-shooty.name: Big an’ Shooty
big-an-shooty.description: In your Shooting phase, this unit’s ranged attacks can re-roll Hit rolls of 1.

idol-of-belligerence.name: Idol of Belligerence
idol-of-belligerence.description: In your Movement phase, when a unit embarked within this unit is selected to make a disembark move, that unit is riled up until the start of your next turn.

waaagh-effigy.name: Waaagh! Effigy
waaagh-effigy.description: This unit is always riled up.

mobile-fortress.name: Mobile Fortress
mobile-fortress.description: Ranged attacks that target this unit have -1 Damage.

mobile-arsenal.name: Mobile Arsenal
mobile-arsenal.description: In your Shooting phase, this unit’s ranged attacks can re-roll Hit rolls of 1.

madcap-artillery.name: Madcap Artillery
madcap-artillery.description:
In your Shooting phase, after this unit has shot, if every Mek Gunz model in it carries the same ranged weapons, pick one enemy unit hit by those attacks. Until the start of your next turn that unit suffers the effect named after the weapon:
• Bubblechukka — wobbled: while it attacks, its targets have the benefit of cover.
• Kustom Mega-kannon — zapped: -1 Leadership.
• Smasha Gun — smashed: -2" Move.
• Traktor Kannon — grounded: it cannot take to the skies.

Keep five Grot Crew tokens next to each Mek Gun and remove one each time it loses a wound; the model itself stands for its last wound.

squig-barrage.name: Squig Barrage
squig-barrage.description: In your Shooting phase, after this unit has shot, pick one enemy unit (not a MONSTER or VEHICLE unit) hit by its Squig Launchas. Until the start of your next turn that unit is covered in Squigs: its attacks have -1 to Hit rolls.

drive-by-skorchin.name: Drive-by Skorchin’
drive-by-skorchin.description: In your Movement phase, you can pick one visible enemy unit (not a MONSTER or VEHICLE unit) within 6" of this unit. Until the end of the turn, that unit cannot be targeted with the Fire Overwatch stratagem.

dread-ard.name: Dread ’Ard
dread-ard.description: Attacks that target this unit have -1 Damage.

spiteful-power-trip.name: Spiteful Power Trip
spiteful-power-trip.description: This unit’s attacks have +1 to Hit rolls against a unit in which no model has a Toughness of 7 or more.

raucous-occupants.name: Raucous Occupants
raucous-occupants.description: While this model is within range of your home objective, add the OC of the models embarked within it to its own OC.

fortification.name: Fortification
fortification.description:
While an enemy unit is engaged only with FORTIFICATION units:
• It can be picked as the target of ranged attacks.
• Ranged attacks against it have -1 to Hit rolls ([CLOSE-QUARTERS] attacks excepted).
• When it is selected to make a Fall Back move and is not Battle-shocked, hazard rolls made for it are passed automatically.

ramshackle-cover.name: Ramshackle Cover
ramshackle-cover.description: A unit that is not fully visible to an attacking model because of this unit has the benefit of cover against that attack.
